actions.name: shortbow
actions.desc: [[/attack extended]]. [[/damage extended]], and the target must succeed on a [[/save]] saving throw or become &Reference[poisoned] for [[lookup @labels.duration activity=vMfBrhdjnxaKy0Wn]]. If its saving throw result is 5 or lower, the poisoned target falls &Reference[unconscious] for the same duration, or until it takes damage or another creature takes an action to shake it awake.

actions.name: invisibility
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} magically turns &reference[invisible] until it attacks or casts a spell, or until its concentration ends (as if concentrating on a spell). Any equipment the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} wears or carries is invisible with it.

actions.name: heart sight
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} touches a creature and magically knows the creature's current emotional state. If the target fails a [[/save]] saving throw, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} also knows the creature's alignment. Celestials, fiends, and undead automatically fail the saving throw.
